breakfast.name: Cherry Coconut Milk Smoothie
ingredients: 1 frozen banana, sliced (2/3 cup frozen slices)
1/3 cup almond or hemp milk, or more as needed
steps: Combine all of the ingredients in a blender and process until smooth.
Add a bit more almond or hemp milk if the mixture is too thick.Tip: To freeze bananas for smoothies, peel the banana and cut into slices.
Place the slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and freeze. Once frozen, transfer to a freezer-friendly container or freezer bag. The bananas will freeze well for up to 4 to 6 months.

lunch.name: Figure Friendly Mushroom and Bacon Strata
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bacon bits, use real bacon bits
steps: Heat non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add oil and saute onion and peppers for 5 minutes to soften.
Add mushrooms and saute another 5 minutes.
Spray baking dish with cooking spray and add bread cubes. Top with mushroom mixture, basil, and salt and pepper to your taste.
Sprinkle with bacon bits and cheese.
Whip eggs and milk together and pour over bread mixture.
Refrigerate for one hour up to overnight.
Bake 20 minutes covered with foil. Uncover and bake another 10 minutes until puffed and lightly browned.

dinner.name: Stuffed Salmon With Tomato-Olive Tapenade
steps: Preheat oven to 350F.Pound salmon fillets and rub with olive oil and dill.In bowl, combine chopped spinach, onions, and garlic. Season with salt.
Spread spinach mixture on salmon fillet. Slice brie and add on top. Carefully roll salmon and tie with string.
Bake for about 15-18 minutes.Chop olives in food processor.
